This means V-14 should be deferred until that shipment arrives rather than consuming tires from the eight we currently have on hand. I'd recommend we prioritize V-11 and V-19 with the eight serviceable tires available now, and handle V-14 once its dedicated shipment arrives. This updated delivery is not yet reflected in the battalion supply tracker, which is why I'm surfacing it now.
